entries.title: Psalms 142:1
segments: ¶<Maschil. Of David. A prayer when he was in the hole of the rock.> The sound of my cry went up to the Lord; with my voice I made my prayer for grace to the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 142:2
segments: I put all my sorrows before him; and made clear to him all my trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 142:3
segments: When my spirit is overcome, your eyes are on my goings; nets have been secretly placed in the way in which I go.

entries.title: Psalms 142:4
segments: ¶Looking to my right side, I saw no man who was my friend: I had no safe place; no one had any care for my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 142:5
segments: I have made my cry to you, O Lord; I have said, You are my safe place, and my heritage in the land of the living.

entries.title: Psalms 142:6
segments: Give ear to my cry, for I am made very low: take me out of the hands of my haters, for they are stronger than I.

entries.title: Psalms 142:7
segments: Take my soul out of prison, so that I may give praise to your name: the upright will give praise because of me; for you have given me a full reward.
